name: Daisy Bead Keychain With Leather Strap
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality faux leather, decorative beads, and durable metal hardware, offering a stylish and practical everyday accessory.
    - Features a soft yet sturdy faux leather strap for a comfortable grip and elegant personalized finish.
    - Decorated with a charming 3D daisy petal design and coordinated bead accents for a fun, cute, and eye-catching look.
    - Includes a durable metal clasp and key ring for secure attachment to keys, bags, purses, backpacks, and accessories. 
    - Available in multiple leather strap color options: Green, Blue, Dark Brown, Light Brown, Pink, Red.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Leather strap size:
             +) Length: 11 cm ~ 4.33 in
             +) Width: 1.7 cm ~ 0.67 in
    - Beaded charm length: 12 cm ~4.72 in
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for clear details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting personalization.
    - The faux leather strap can be customized with 1-sided printing or 2-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized keychain and a decorative accessory.
    - Designed for attaching to keys, handbags, backpacks, purses, zipper pulls, and wristlets.
    - The faux leather strap provides a comfortable grip and makes keys easier to carry or find.
    - The daisy bead charm adds extra decorative appeal and gives the keychain a more fun, playful, and stylish look.
    - Suitable for daily use, gifting, bag decoration, and personalized accessory styling.
    - Perfect for adding a cute and meaningful touch to everyday essentials.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for teachers, moms, friends, sisters, coworkers, family members, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, Teacher Appreciation Day, holidays, back-to-school gifts, thank-you gifts, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves cute floral accessories and personalized keepsakes.
    - Great for bag charms, key accessories, small gift items, and meaningful everyday use.
    - A lovely gift choice that combines function, style, and personal sentiment.
    - Adds a sweet, cheerful, and memorable touch to any accessory collection

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Daisy Bead Keychain With Leather Strap

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
